summary.en: Greek and Roman thought on change, measure, form, ends, the good life and the city, from Heraclitus to the Stoics, Sextus, Polybius and Cicero. No live chapter or front names these authors or reads their doctrines, so nearly every entry is a connection proposed here by an AI reader and not a statement of the account; the few the account states in part, or that stand only in a study, say so. All rest on AI knowledge unchecked against any text, and speak for no tradition. Agreement is thin: where it is with a law it is with the form of one clause, often near the definition, and others rest on a thesis or a reader's join. Divergence is heavy: logos, substance, Forms, natural ends and rank, natural law, knowing as enough, the limit of goods against C, human nature behind faction. Parmenides, Plato on flux, Epicurus and Sextus are contrary tests.

name.en: Heraclitus: other and other waters in the same river

source.locator: DK 22 B12; B49a and B91 are later reports, their authenticity disputed

sense.en: On those stepping into the same rivers, other and other waters flow: the river is called the same while its water differs. 'You cannot step twice' is a later sharpening (Plato, Plutarch) that many scholars doubt is his. Whether the point is sameness through change or flux as such is disputed.

reading.en: Same under one class, other under another: at a coarse class (the river) a line goes on, at a fine class (this water) lines begin and end, which is carrying renewal at two grains. The law holds for every relation and class and forbids none, and no law picks 'river' or 'water'. The account's 火传 comes from 庄子, not from him: a shared form, no lineage. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root): continuation is 缘 joined to sameness under a class; 'the criterion is E and no other choice enters'; 'Continuation is a relation, not an identity'. Fission (a witness): sameness read along lines either way is not transitive.

Theorem (root), every carrier, relation and pair of classes: a carrying renewal (the pattern continues under L while a fine line begins under E) is an alteration; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of what the river only shows: fission, merges, the regions of generation, keeping and degeneration, and that as language the grammar forbids nothing.

source_adds.en: The saying as paradox: if B49a is his, a thing both is and is not the same. Class-relativity dissolves that, and he may have meant it not to dissolve.

name.en: Heraclitus: fire kindling and going out in measures

source.locator: DK 22 B30, B31, B90, B94, as recalled

sense.en: This cosmos, made by no god or man, was, is and will be ever-living fire, kindling in measures and going out in measures. All things are an exchange for fire, as goods for gold. The sun will not overstep its measures, or the Furies, ministers of justice, will find it out.

reading.en: Stated of the whole cosmos, measure gets narrower places here. Exchange: with the rest counted every world balances, by the reading and discovering nothing, condition by condition, with no one medium as gold is for goods. Overstepping: T1 conjectures that what persists through renewals of a condition it depends on has kept the joint draw within the margin; the margin's exactness is proved on whole-number models. His sun is no drawer on a renewal, so that part is likeness. Fire is 02's illustration only. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World), 'By the reading': with the rest counted, every world balances, and a world's own flow balances exactly where the rest is never active. 'Balance is not removed: nothing comes from nothing becomes feasibility, a premise located in the law.'

Thesis T1, conjectured: whatever persists through many renewal cycles of a condition it depends on 'has had the joint draw on it, its own with every other drawer's, kept within the regime's margin'. Passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings (ONE-PAGE).

Theorem (the regime; any giving law, whole numbers): under its hypotheses, a level up to hi ends exactly where it starts below H + y, 'the point of no return is exact'. 'They locate an end, ordering nothing.'

account_adds.en: An exact point of no return, that draws add superadditively up to one, that two draws each held alone can end a condition together, and what would refute T1.

source_adds.en: A single ever-living fire as what all is, all exchanged through one medium, an unmade eternal cosmos, and a measure that is guarded. The account has no arche and no eternity, and in it a margin can be crossed with nothing pursuing.

name.en: Heraclitus: war the father of all, strife as justice

source.locator: DK 22 B53, B80, B51, as recalled

sense.en: War is father of all and king of all; it shows some as gods, some as men, some slaves, some free. All things come to be through strife and necessity, and justice is strife. What differs agrees with itself, an attunement of opposed tension, as of bow and lyre.

reading.en: Stated of everything, strife gets narrower places here. What is strictly opposed is relative position: a part's rise needs another's fall, by the counting alone, while totals are not so bound and position does not protect. Bow and lyre has no close form: two-sided regulation's "opposing" pushes a level back toward m from either side, not two parts strained together, and its record reads 老子's 张弓, a shared image. Conflict stays real and is not made the root. No law calls it just. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type for the counting): 'a part's rise needs another part's fall'. 'Position does not protect': with balance across n steps of joint excess, a part needing more than the level left is not active, its position not entering.

Theorem (World): with balance at the condition, within the gap to m, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever. Record: not shown 'That holding a level is good'.
Thesis: 'Joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility'; 'conflict and difference stay real'.

account_adds.en: Where opposition is exact and where it stops: positions bound the total from below and never from above; giving that waits on giving (05) needs no strife.

source_adds.en: Strife as what generates all and as justice, and a tension holding a thing in being. Generation as 02 defines it names no opposition. Two-sided regulation calls nothing attuned or just.

name.en: Heraclitus: one logos by which all comes to be, common to all

source.locator: DK 22 B1, B2, B50, B114, as recalled

sense.en: All things come to be according to this logos, which holds always though people fail to grasp it. It is common, yet most live as if with a private understanding. Listening to it and not to him, it is wise to agree that all things are one, and human laws are nourished by one divine law. What logos means here is disputed.

reading.en: What he cares for most, unreached by the river entry. His logos is one thing all happens by, found by those who attend. Here a law 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it', and one unfolding, a thesis argued, forbids a law standing outside what it holds of. What is common here is formed: a pool tells apart what some member does, and a shared code is among forms in use. 'One' shares a word, not a reference. [AI reading]

says.en: A law of the theory 'holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'.

Thesis, argued: 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it'. Forbids 'an explanation that needs a determination no relation carries', such as 'a law standing outside what it holds of'. 'Neither shows that reality has none.'

Theorem (any type; premises by row): 'the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use'; an order brings every start to agreement exactly where it gives all formations one origin. 'Being joined through couplings is not enough'.
Theorem (World): some selection through the pooled coupling separates two histories exactly when some member does not couple them alike.

account_adds.en: How a common understanding forms and where it cannot: agreement needs one origin, and joined couplings are not enough.

source_adds.en: A common account there to be heard, private understanding as a kind of sleep, a divine law, and agreement with it as wisdom. The account has no such law, and its 明 grows by what is joined, not by waking to one thing.

name.en: Anaximander: things pay penalty to one another in the order of time

source.locator: DK 12 B1 (Simplicius on Aristotle's Physics); how much of the wording is his is disputed

sense.en: From what things arise, into that they also perish, by necessity; for they pay penalty and retribution to one another for their injustice according to the ordering of time. Arising and ending are read as a settling of accounts, a moral order in nature.

reading.en: His arising and ending are a settling of accounts, a justice. Here balance is a model's premise, or holds by the reading once the rest is counted, and the first law bounds amounts in a closed family. None of it evaluates: no law says a loss is a harm, and ending repays no one. Heraclitus's guarded measures (B94) and one divine law (B114) diverge the same way. [AI reading]

says.en: 'No law evaluates: none says a loss is a harm or restraint better.' The ethics adds two premises, the continuation condition for scope and C for order, 'neither asserted, warrant open'.
First law: 'the spine's name for Flow.Gainless: a closed family without repetition gets back at most what is taken from it'.
A law of the theory 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'; it forbids through its hypotheses.

account_adds.en: That a balance ranks nothing, and that any ranking needs C or a premise in its place, stated and unasserted.

source_adds.en: Necessity and justice in the becoming itself, and an unbounded (apeiron) from which things arise. He would read the account's silence on what the ledger means as stopping short.

name.en: Parmenides: what is, is; coming-to-be is extinguished

source.locator: DK 28 B8 (with B2, B6), as recalled

sense.en: What is, is: ungenerated, imperishable, whole, unmoved and complete. Coming-to-be is extinguished and perishing unheard of, since what is not can be neither thought nor said. Mortal opinion names change and two forms, and that way deceives. How 'is' is meant here (existential, predicative, veridical) is disputed.

reading.en: The strongest test of the root's own form. The grammar states change tenselessly: a net and its reach, each theorem timeless, with no relation of presence in time. Parmenides can say this concedes his case: a static whole on which change is a pattern read off. The account's reply is only that beginning and ending are positions under a class. 'One unfolding' and his One share a word, not a reference. [AI reading]

says.en: 'An occurrence in a line either continues something or not, and is either continued or not. Those two questions fix its position, and the answers depend on the class.'
'The grammar has no relation of presence in time'; causal-set growth is one model where one can be read and the question asked, given covariance, a premise of the model.
Thesis, argued: 'there is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it'; that the whole theory needs no independent entity 'is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.'

targets.part: the thesis statement, argued and not proved

says.en: 'The generations a poisoning forecloses occur nowhere on the course taken, so they lie on no line'; 'a loss is read by comparing courses'. An AI reading, argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Answers, per reading of presence, on one growth model; time as the reach of the condition relation, a strict order where that relation has no cycle.

source_adds.en: The argument from what can be thought to what is, which the account neither answers nor uses, though it reads a loss against what occurs nowhere on the course taken; and the claim that plurality itself is incoherent, which a relation needing two relata does not meet.

name.en: Parmenides, Melissus and Lucretius: nothing comes from nothing

source.work: Parmenides, On Nature; Melissus; Lucretius, De rerum natura
source.locator: DK 28 B8.7-10; DK 30 B1; Lucretius I.146-264, as recalled

sense.en: Nothing can arise from what is not, and, for Lucretius, nothing passes into nothing. For Parmenides it is a necessity of thought, part of denying all coming-to-be; for the atomists a principle of nature, argued from what we see, since things need seeds and conditions.

reading.en: The account has this sentence and moves it: 'nothing comes from nothing becomes feasibility, a premise located in the law'. With the rest counted every world balances by the reading, the rest idle exactly where the course is feasible. Locally it has content: under balance every rise is given by a supported formation, and T1, conjectured, forbids a condition below a need returning with nothing given from beyond. His necessity becomes a hypothesis, and a model's balance can fail. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World), 'By the reading': with the rest counted, every world balances; where the law reads only what has stood, 'the rest is idle exactly where the course is feasible'. 'Balance is not removed: nothing comes from nothing becomes feasibility, a premise located in the law.'
Theorem (World): 'Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise of a condition is given by a supported formation taking part'. Each premise is needed.

Thesis T1, conjectured. Forbids: 'a condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond'. Passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings (ONE-PAGE).

account_adds.en: Which premise carries it in each law, and, in the periphery, its reading under the exergy balance and the second law at the unit.

source_adds.en: Not stated: that it is a necessity of thought, and that nothing passes into nothing. Here an ending is a position under a class, and what is lost need not be anywhere. Atoms as what is conserved are not read.

name.en: Plato: Forms, and being set against becoming

source.locator: Timaeus 27d-28a; Phaedo 78c-79a; Republic V-VII (the Good, VI 509b); his own objections, Parmenides 130-135, as recalled

sense.en: What always is has no becoming and is grasped by thought; what becomes and perishes never fully is and is grasped by opinion. Particulars are what they are by participating in a Form, and the Good stands beyond being as the source of being and knowing. Plato presses objections to this himself.

reading.en: The account puts sameness in a class, an equivalence supplied as a parameter, and what the relation never tells apart in the core, read off the net. So a stable pattern needs no separate being, and 08 forbids 'a law standing outside what it holds of' as explanation. A Platonist replies that a law proved once of every relation is just such a Form. Argued on both sides, not refuted. [AI reading]

says.en: The core of a class is 'the greatest symmetric relation' inside it that the relation never tells apart, and it 'always exists' (theorem, root). Laws hold for every class, and none picks one.
Forbids 'an explanation that needs a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own, or a law standing outside what it holds of'. Argued, not proved.
A law of the theory 'holds of every relation, carrier or model its hypotheses admit. It is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'.

account_adds.en: Which pattern a given net carries, exactly, given a class; and the admission that equality on the carrier is used and not derived.

source_adds.en: The Good at the root of being and knowing, where the account has no value at all; and a reason why classes and proofs hold, which the account takes as given.

name.en: Plato's cave: honours for predicting shadows

source.locator: VII, 514a-517a (516c-e on the prizes; 517a on the returning one), as recalled

sense.en: Prisoners see only shadows and give prizes to whoever best recalls and predicts their order. One freed and returned is laughed at, his eyes said to be ruined, and they would kill him if they could. For Plato the ascent ends in the Good, and seeing it fits one to rule. It is offered as an image of education.

reading.en: The prize has a form, near the definition: a selection through couplings reaches only what couples in, so the best predictor of shadows is selected and what lies beyond changes no selection. That far a law. The rest is a reader's join: the returner's fate as 03's 'refusal read as resistance', and the lock under a rule read from its share, a premise. His ascent has a top, and seeing it makes one good. Here 明 is as wide as the couplings joined, with no top, and seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. Near-definitional; 'its force lies in the supplied premise' that a selector selects through just those.

Theorem (any type): under its premises, 'from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked'; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, 'a sufficient way out'.
Reading [AI, D65]: locked seeking has 'feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost'.
'**Seeing is not valuing**: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.'

account_adds.en: Exactly what a closed reading cannot tell, and what can turn it: a change of the law, of how the rule reads, or of the selection.

source_adds.en: The Good as the end of ascent, being and knowing as one order, and a duty to go back down. The account has no top reading and no duty; it cannot call the shadows false without a standard the selector lacks.

name.en: Plato's Stranger: being as the power to act or be acted on

source.locator: 247d-e, as recalled

sense.en: The Eleatic Stranger offers those who count only bodies a mark of being: whatever has any power to act on anything or be acted on, even slightly and once, really is. It is offered provisionally as a boundary mark, and the dialogue goes on to the friends of Forms.

reading.en: Reality marked by conditioning or being conditioned has the form of 08's demand: a determination making a difference to how anything goes on is carried by a relation, and one making none explains nothing. Configurations alike in every stated relation pass the same tests. The Lean concerns representations; the thesis is argued, so this is agreement with a thesis and not a law. Not a descent, and the Stranger does not say all is relation. [AI reading]

says.en: 'a determination making a difference to how anything goes on is carried by that relation, and one making none explains nothing'. That is argued; 'By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation'.
Theorem (any process): configurations related by a bisimulation are alike: they realize the same claims and pass the same tests.

account_adds.en: What the thesis forbids, three cases that look like refuters, and two live defeaters.

source_adds.en: Power as a mark even of soul and Forms, in a dialogue that keeps them; capacity held by what acts, where the account's relation needs no capacity behind it.

name.en: Plato's Theaetetus: flux in every respect refutes itself

source.locator: 181c-183b, as recalled

sense.en: If a thing changes both in place and in quality at once, no name holds of it even while spoken: seeing is no more seeing than not, and no answer is more right than another. So a flux in every respect cannot be stated. It is aimed at followers of Heraclitus, in a version Plato partly constructs.

reading.en: The account escapes by never asserting change in every respect: continuation is relative to a class. But that grants the argument's demand, something held still: in each statement the class is a fixed equivalence, and a changing rule is taken into the occurrence on a larger carrier, under a further class. And every single condition is a continuation under some class, so the class must be chosen. Kept as a test. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Every single condition is a continuation under some class' (`«任一缘可为续»`): containment in 缘 is necessary only. Not shown: 'That a class is warranted: constancy says only that a class agrees with 缘; under the full relation every class is constant.'

Theorem (root; on processes and the two-level step): a move of a process is a relation; a rule that itself goes on is read in the state's regularity, the state's class constant under every move exactly where the rule makes no difference to the state.

account_adds.en: That the question 'which class' is exact and left open by the laws, and is where the crux lands.

source_adds.en: That speech and knowledge need stability the speaker cannot merely stipulate. The account stipulates its classes and does not say what licenses that.

name.en: Plato's Republic VIII: each regime undone by its own good

source.locator: VIII, 546a on all that comes to be perishing; 555b wealth; 562b freedom, as recalled

sense.en: Each regime falls through its defining good pursued without limit: oligarchy through insatiable wealth, democracy through insatiable freedom, which ends in tyranny. Even the best city decays, since all that has come to be must perish. How seriously the sequence and its marriage number are meant is disputed.

reading.en: A target that cannot be met at rest has an exact form here. Whether it undoes the regime depends on what is lost: a kept rule can end the level it draws on (05, a reading), while a lock outlives a growing loss it does not depend on, until the law, the reading or the selection changes. No law reads a regime. Nor must what forms end, except where every line does: under a constant class no line ends after its first step. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type, determined law for rest): 'More than now' is met only by change, and met at every step needs an open world, no list holding its configurations. How a target forms is not modelled.

Theorem (any type): under its premises, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, 'a sufficient way out'. That actual rules meet this is a premise.
Reading [AI, new]: 'a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule, and it ends the level'. 'That any actual institution meets the hypotheses is a correspondence duty, not shown here'.

Theorem (root), 'Constancy never lets a continuation end': 'under a constant class a line never ends after its first step'. 07 §4.6: in a net where every line ends no class under which anything continues is constant.

account_adds.en: That a loop can outlast a loss it does not depend on, which his sequence does not allow, and exactly what turns it.

source_adds.en: A named sequence of regimes, each with a type of soul, and justice as what the decline is measured against. The account has no kinds of regime and no such measure.

name.en: Thrasymachus: justice is the advantage of the stronger

source.locator: Republic I, 338c-339a, 343b-344c; Politics III.7 (1279a-b) on deviant regimes, as recalled

sense.en: Each ruling group makes laws for its own advantage and declares that just for those it rules, so justice is the advantage of the stronger. Socrates presses that rulers can mistake their advantage. Aristotle sorts regimes: correct ones rule for the common good, deviant ones for the rulers' own. Whether Thrasymachus gives a definition or a cynical report is disputed.

reading.en: Said of every city, this gets a conditional form: shaping the rule is selected where what comes back to shapers at least meets its cost, and a rule read from the share it raises locks; 'That actual rules read the share is the premise'. His "nothing else" 07 splits: whether a standard gains influence, recognizes its target, has warrant or is followed are four questions, and it can be wrong. Socrates's reply has a form too: a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, 'whatever p comes to every member alike'; with nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step.
Theorem (any type): under its premises the course locks; 'That actual rules read the share is the premise.' 'The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours'.
'Whether a standard so formed gains influence, recognizes its target, has warrant or is followed are four questions; it can be wrong'. On the thesis of one unfolding, argued, not proved.
Reading [AI, new]: 'a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule, and it ends the level'.

account_adds.en: What decides the sign of the selection for shaping: what comes back to the shapers alone against the cost. A shared part coming to every member alike does not change the direction (07, a reading, D68).

source_adds.en: The debunking itself: that 'just' names only power's interest. The account gives no verdict that a rulers' standard is false, and T7, conjectured, is its nearest test. Aristotle's common good as a measure is not read.

name.en: Glaucon and Epicurus: justice as a compact

source.locator: Republic II, 358e-359b; Principal Doctrines 31-38, as recalled

sense.en: Glaucon reports, not holding it himself, that justice is a compromise: unable to do wrong unpunished or to bear it, people agree to do neither. Epicurus: natural justice is a pledge of mutual advantage not to harm or be harmed, shifting with what is useful, and there is no justice toward animals or peoples that cannot make such a pact.

reading.en: 05's thesis refuses this as explanation: joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests or bargaining. That is argued, and no law states a pact. Nearest are a code reached among forms in use and 07's legitimate shared procedure, a commitment. His limit, no justice where no pact can be made, has a rival's form: a significance bounded by a region. The condition for scope and C for order would differ, unasserted. The dossier records the gap. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis: 'Joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility'; 'conflict and difference stay real'.
Theorem (any type): a statement reading only the dynamics, holding with some significance, holds with 'a significance bounded by any region leaving a formation out, a *rival* of the condition'.
'without a unique answer a legitimate shared procedure decides and keeps residual responsibilities'; J1-J4 follow from neither the condition nor C.
Known weakness [dossier, AI]: 'Some families of views appear only as objections or not at all: contractualism, virtue ethics, particularism'.

account_adds.en: Where agreement on a code cannot arise from a symmetric start, and what breaks the symmetry.

source_adds.en: Justice as having no being apart from compacts, and advantage as its whole ground. The account's standards also form, yet of each it asks whether it has warrant, a further question he would decline.

name.en: Protagoras: man the measure

source.work: Protagoras, as reported in Plato's Theaetetus
source.locator: Theaetetus 151e-152c; self-refutation 170e-171c, as recalled. His own text is lost

sense.en: Man is the measure of all things: of what is, that it is, of what is not, that it is not. Plato reads this as: things are for each as they appear to each, and replies that it must then count its own denier true. Whether the historical Protagoras meant individual relativity is uncertain.

reading.en: The account keeps a first half: standards form within the unfolding, none outside owns value, and a perspectivist denies the condition consistently. It refuses a second: a standard so formed 'can be wrong', and a selector's couplings bound what it can read without making that true. Whether a standard has influence, recognition, warrant or compliance are four questions. Protagoras would decline the two premises, which are unasserted, their warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: 'positions, regions and standards form within the unfolding; none outside it owns value.' Whether a standard gains influence, recognizes its target, has warrant or is followed are four questions; 'it can be wrong'. On the thesis of one unfolding, argued, not proved.

Open. 'a perspectivist denies the condition consistently (bounded_rival)', so a warrant grounding the condition comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; 'these do not show that none exists'.

account_adds.en: Scope and order held apart: the continuation condition fixes whose losses count, C gives order, and a measure's reach is exact: what couples in.

source_adds.en: That each appearance is true for its holder, and a practice of argument built on that. Which the live account does not hold.

name.en: Socrates: expertise overreaching, and knowing the limit of what one knows

source.locator: 21b-23b, as recalled

sense.en: Examining the reputedly wise, Socrates finds craftsmen who truly know their craft and, on that strength, claim wisdom on the greatest matters. His human wisdom is not supposing he knows what he does not. The oracle frames this, and the passage is not a claim that nothing can be known.

reading.en: Stands in a study: CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM reads the Apology, in Jowett, as distinguishing real knowledge from self-assigned reach. Proposed here as a structural reading: live, the reach half has a law and a one-line AI reading: selections reach only what couples in, what lies beyond changes none of them, and 'situational awareness is 明 of one's own reach'. So overreach cannot be read from inside one's own couplings; another's can show it. That is no statement of his humility. Socrates is not named live. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; no premise): two histories are selected alike by every selection through a formation's couplings exactly when they are alike through them. 'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.' Blindness (balance on what couples in): every selection through them treats the levels with and without a part beyond alike.
Reading [AI, D20, D26, D45]: 明 is a relation, as wide as the couplings joined to a selection; 'situational awareness is 明 of one's own reach'; 'a law used beyond its scope is a wrong model'.

account_adds.en: What a coupling bound is, exactly, and what joins another's couplings to one's own (pools, models, measurement), nearest his examining others.

source_adds.en: Stands at root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md line 223, a study. Not stated live: that expertise tends to overreach, examination as a practice, and a life spent on it.

searched: overreach in chapters, fronts, review, GLOSSARY
read: 03-KNOWING.md: selection through couplings and blindness, the 明 reading at line 99

name.en: Socrates: no one errs willingly; Aristotle on akrasia

source.work: Plato, Protagoras, Meno; Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics
source.locator: Protagoras 345d-e, 352b-358d; Meno 77b-78b; NE VII.2-3 (1145b21-1147b19), as recalled

sense.en: Socrates in these dialogues holds that no one does wrong knowingly: knowledge is not dragged about by passion, and whoever truly knows the better does it, so virtue is knowledge. Aristotle replies that this contradicts what plainly appears, and locates failure in knowledge had and not used in acting. How far this is the historical Socrates is disputed.

reading.en: The account says the reverse: seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, 'accurate prediction does not entail concern'. Widening what a selection can separate makes no difference matter. In one frozen test on language models told what to do, seeing a dependent was not enough: kept in 3 of 10 seasons with the community's goal, 8 with the scope, in one model of two, with talk. Aristotle's knowledge not used has a narrower form: 'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry'. [AI reading]

says.en: '**Seeing is not valuing**: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.' '**Coupling is not compliance**: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.'
Assessment: 'Stabilizing a belief is not validity, operational compatibility forces no metaphysics, and accurate prediction does not entail concern'.

Thesis T4, partly passed: IN1, frozen: 'with talk, one model kept the seen dependent in 8 of 10 seasons with the scope against 3 with the community's goal and 0 unseen'; the other failed even with talk.
'A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.'

account_adds.en: What knowing alone does not do, as a reach law; and what would test it in a system: a scope installed, against one only seen. That reach law gives no order: the continuation condition for scope and C for order stay unasserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: Knowledge as a power which, had in full, acts; virtue as that knowledge. A Socratic would answer that what the account calls seeing is not yet knowing the good, and no test here reads that. Models told are not persons.

name.en: Aristotle: primary substance, with relation least of all an entity

source.locator: Categories 5, 2a11ff; Metaphysics N.1, 1088a22ff; Metaphysics Z on form, as recalled

sense.en: Primary substance is neither said of nor in a subject: this man, this horse. All else is said of or in these, so substances ground the other categories. Relation is least of all a substance or entity, an affection of something else. What substance finally is (form, in Metaphysics Z) is argued at length.

reading.en: The direct opposite: here relation is the one kind of symbol, and the carrier 'is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations'. Yet 08 names his case without naming him as a live defeater, 'that relations need relata with natures of their own', and equality on the carrier is used and not derived. Nothing here refutes substance. [AI reading]

says.en: 'The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences.' The carrier is a parameter; 'Equality on the carrier is a commitment of the model'.

'Two such arguments are live: that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.' Equality on the carrier is the nearest case, read as belonging to the representation; 'that reading is not shown'.

account_adds.en: A statement of what the demand is: state the relation carrying what is cited, where a law or a test can read it.

source_adds.en: That a thing's what-it-is explains its relations and not the reverse, and an independent subject of predication. The account's thesis forbids this as explanation and does not refute it.

name.en: Aristotle: a persisting subject for change, form through passing matter

source.work: Aristotle, On Generation and Corruption; Physics
source.locator: GC I.3-5 (319b on alteration against coming-to-be; 321b-322a on growth); Physics I.7, as recalled

sense.en: Change needs a subject that persists. Where the subject persists and a quality differs it is alteration; where nothing perceptible persists it is coming-to-be. In growth the form remains while matter comes and goes: flesh stays flesh in form though each bit is replaced. Form is an actuality and a cause of the living thing, not a pattern read off it.

reading.en: He says this of all change; here it holds under a class. An occurrence alters where it continues another under one class while a finer class tells them apart, and begins where it continues nothing, so one step can alter or begin by the class read. The persistence half reads as carrying renewal, and growth nearest as one constraint regenerated from the flow it regulates. Nothing underlies: a line goes on under a supplied class, and a whole is 'coincidence of activity, not constitution'. [AI reading]

says.en: 'An occurrence in a line either continues something or not, and is either continued or not. Those two questions fix its position, and the answers depend on the class.' `y` alters from `x` where it continues `x` under `E` while another class tells the two apart.

Theorem (World): while the whole stays active from some step on, where parts are brief no d steps pass without one arising. The record: near-definitional; 'That a whole is constituted by its parts does not follow'.

Theorem (root), every carrier, relation and pair of classes: generation is where, along some branch, the pattern goes on and from every member a carrying renewal between members lies ahead; keeping goes on with none.

Reading [AI, new]: the member rebuilt from the level is 'the family's model of an organism, and a minimal one: one constraint, with turnover, regenerated from the flow it regulates', below closure of constraints and autopoiesis, 'each of which asks more'.

account_adds.en: That persistence can also be by keeping, with no renewal; and the exits: a part that never ends, or infinitely many active at once, lets a whole persist with nothing arising.

source_adds.en: Form as cause and actuality, the soul as form of the living body, a subject necessary for change at all. Plutarch's ship poses the same puzzle in a made thing.

name.en: Aristotle against the Megarians: a builder not building can build

source.locator: Theta 3 (1046b29-1047a10); Theta 8 on the priority of actuality, as recalled

sense.en: The Megarians say a thing can act only while it acts. Aristotle replies that then a builder not building would not be a builder, and what is not now seeing would be blind many times a day. So capacity is not its exercise, and what is possible need not be happening. Yet actuality is prior to potentiality.

reading.en: One choice in 07 has this shape. The whole-run and stepwise readings count what occurs; the possibility reading counts what is admitted, active or not, and they rank differently: a formation drawing within renewal, against its absence, is higher on two and a tie on the third. 'No reading is chosen.' Admission is levels meeting requirements, a relation, not a power held by the thing. The join is this reader's. Comparison under C for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: 'At each step a formation is admitted where its conditions' levels meet its requirements.' No significance or standpoint enters.

Conditional (C; World). Under whole-run, stepwise and possibility (admitted, active or not) readings, a course's ranking differs by case; a formation drawing within renewal, against its absence: presence higher, presence higher, tie. 'No reading is chosen.'

account_adds.en: That the difference changes verdicts, case by case, and that none of the readings is shown right.

source_adds.en: Capacity as held by what acts, its priority after act, and the argument against the Megarians itself. The account's possibility is a condition of the levels and leaves out a capacity behind it.

name.en: Aristotle: natural ends, and the good read from the function

source.locator: NE I.7, 1097b22-1098a20; Physics II.8; Politics I.2, as recalled

sense.en: Nature acts for ends and does nothing in vain. A thing's good lies in its function, and the human function is activity of soul according to reason, so the human good is read from what a human is. Modern readers dispute how much the ethics rests on this.

reading.en: The reverse of 07 §1: a function gives a standard, and no law says a standard is a significance. With significance free, no satisfiable statement reading only the represented dynamics entails the continuation condition, and a ranking needs C or a premise in its place, both unasserted, warrant open. T8's "for life" comes nearest his kind-relative good, yet starts from what acting presupposes. The theorem concerns a representation with no final cause, which he denies is nature. Kept, not settled. [AI reading]

says.en: 'No law says that a standard which formed is a significance.' Glossary, standard: 'That a standard is met says nothing of whether meeting it has significance'.

Theorem (any type): where there is a standpoint and a formation, a statement reading only the dynamics and entailing the condition holds of no dynamics. 'the result shows non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined'.
The continuation condition fixes scope, C gives order; 'Neither is asserted.' 'A ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place'.

Thesis T8, argued: 'For life says whose way it is, not whose losses count'; the stance 'starts from what acting presupposes, held de se', 'not from a wish that life go on'. No verdict binding every possible mind.

account_adds.en: That the is-ought gap here is 'near-definitional', with scope apart from order as a clarification (08).

source_adds.en: Ends in nature, and an ethics from kind. The account's thesis forbids 'a self with a nature of its own' as explanation, and 04's organism model, a constraint regenerated from the flow it regulates, names no end.

name.en: Aristotle: the human a political animal, the city prior to the individual

source.locator: I.2 (1253a1-29), as recalled

sense.en: The human is by nature a political animal; one who needs no city is a beast or a god. The city is prior by nature to the individual as the whole to the part: a hand cut off is a hand in name only. The city exists by nature for living well. How the priority is meant is disputed.

reading.en: A shared start and a parting. No one here is a center apart from relations, and for him no one is a human apart from a city. But here 'a collective is a region of formed relations', 'not a unit with an interest of its own', and a whole is 'coincidence of activity, not constitution', its parts supplied. His priority is of nature and end. No law here makes city or part prior; that joint activity is so explained is a thesis. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis: 'Joint activity is explained from actual relations, not opposed interests, bargaining or a fixed common utility: a collective is a region of formed relations', 'not a unit with an interest of its own; conflict and difference stay real'.
Theorem (World): a whole arises only as a part arises. Record, not shown: 'That a whole is constituted by its parts does not follow: being a whole is coincidence of activity.' Parts are supplied.
'A center is a formation; its own region is its closure under some relation of the unfolding'. On the thesis of one unfolding, argued and not proved.

account_adds.en: Regions read along a relation, which may overlap, with no one of them picked by a law.

source_adds.en: The city as the complete community, natural, with an end; speech as what makes it possible (1253a9-18). 08's whole is everything in the one unfolding, not a city.

name.en: Aristotle and Plato: some by nature rule, some by nature are ruled

source.locator: Politics I.4-6 (1254a-1255b), I.13; NE VIII.11; Republic III, 415a-c, as recalled

sense.en: Aristotle holds that some humans are slaves by nature, lacking deliberation, and benefit from being ruled, while granting that many actually enslaved are not such, and that a slave can be a friend as a human. Women too are ranked. Plato's myth of metals sorts citizens by what is in them. Neither is incidental to their political thought.

reading.en: Rank read from a nature is what 08's thesis forbids as explanation, 'a self with a nature of its own'. But the account has no refutation of him, and should say so. A significance leaving the enslaved out is a rival, and a perspectivist denies the condition consistently; the condition, unasserted, would count their losses, C decides no mixed case, and 07 shows no right. 'Informed harm' is its named hard rival. A limit to report, not a gap to paper over. [AI reading]

says.en: Forbids 'an explanation that needs a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own'. Argued, not proved.
'A privileged relation is costly, not refuted; a perspectivist holding significance relative all the way down denies the condition consistently'.

Reading [AI, D65], after the theorem: 'informed harm (a harmful arrangement kept knowingly, no loss returning), the hard rival, which tests the inference from one unfolding to goodwill without refuting normative grounds'.
Not shown: 'Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance'. Neither the condition nor C is asserted, warrant open.

account_adds.en: The exact form of such an exclusion: a significance bounded by a region with a point outside, and the witness where a part retains everything for itself and loses another.

source_adds.en: A hierarchy argued from capacity, and the claim that the ruled benefit. The account's one case against it is a thesis that forbids explanations and no observation; it gives his empirical premise no test and no one a right.

name.en: Self-sufficiency as the mark of the good and of the city

source.work: Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics; Politics; Epicurus, Letter to Menoeceus
source.locator: NE I.7 (1097b6-21), X.7; Politics I.2 (1252b27-1253a1), VII.5 (1326b26-30); Menoeceus 130, as recalled

sense.en: The final good is self-sufficient, making life choiceworthy and lacking nothing. Aristotle means with family, friends and city, not a solitary life. The city reaches the limit of self-sufficiency, best having all and needing nothing; the contemplative life and a god come nearest. Epicurus counts self-sufficiency a great good.

reading.en: Read of exchange, where Politics VII.5 reads it, this has a bound. Under balance and dissipation a finite family, enclosed around from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, 'cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it', so a city needing nothing holds only for a time. That holds at whole-number units, each taking step losing one; a halving stock never rests. His sufficiency for living well is not this: no law reads lacking nothing. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): 'a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it'. 'Where losses can shrink geometrically the argument does not apply'.
Theorem (World): under its premises 'arising without end leaves no step from which every step is enclosed'; each premise needed, by a witness without it.

Theorem (World; witnesses): under the first law, the family without repetition, 'at arbitrarily late steps the rest gives it net or it is not closed'; 'a finite balanced world under the first law has no such course'. Passing every bound uses natural-number amounts. That the wider is better is C's, unasserted.

account_adds.en: An exact form of an 'absolute self', a family fed from nothing beyond itself (08), and what keeping widening needs: gain from beyond a finite family. That the wider is better would be C's, for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: Sufficiency as lacking nothing for living well, in an activity and not a stock, and with others by his own qualification. That the sage's virtue or a god's activity is enough is not read.

name.en: Aristotle: practical wisdom and the particular case

source.locator: VI.5, VI.8 (1142a), VI.9 (on good deliberation), VI.11; II.2 (1103b34-1104a9); V.10 on equity, as recalled

sense.en: Practical wisdom deliberates well about what is good for living as a whole. It grasps particulars as well as universals, since action concerns particulars; ethics admits no exact rule, and the grasp is nearer perception of the case. It takes experience, so the young lack it.

reading.en: He says no exact rule reaches the particular. Here a judgment through couplings is one response per class of what they cannot tell apart, existing exactly where the acts' kernels cover the situations, and, given choice, a rule from readings then exists; too coarse a reading fails, as with his equity correcting a law too general. So where a rule can serve is exact, and he may refuse that form. The requirement is supplied, and for him finding it is the wisdom. The match 'proves no coverage of wisdom'. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; requirement supplied and fixed before the outcome): a common response over a reading exists exactly where the acts' kernels cover the situations. Given choice over the readings, a rule from readings exists exactly where such a response does. 'which requirement is right it does not say'.

Theorem (core, given a choice over the readings): a policy reading an observation meets the declared conditions exactly where every observation class admits a common admissible action. 'Inquiry can resolve such a conflict but changes the history the response occurs in'.
Reading [AI, D26]: checked laws 'match aspects of wisdom', among them judgment (a common response). 'The matching proves no coverage of wisdom, and the warrant of judgment goes through 07.'
'Choices take more, following from neither the condition nor C': a reading of living, the lifting L and the commitments J1-J4.

account_adds.en: The exact cost of a coarse reading, a checked case where inquiry can cross a floor before its response arrives, and the naming of each premise a choice takes.

source_adds.en: Deliberation about living well as a whole; perception of the case as not reducible to a rule; formation by experience. Dossier P admits virtue ethics and particularism 'appear only as objections or not at all'.

name.en: Aristotle: cleverness is not practical wisdom

sense.en: Cleverness reaches whatever target is set, and is praised only if the target is noble, otherwise it is knavery. Practical wisdom needs it, and also the virtue that makes the aim right: one cannot be fully good without practical wisdom, nor practically wise without virtue.

reading.en: Part is stated live without his name: reach is apart from aim. A target is any condition, 'which requirement is right it does not say', 'accurate prediction does not entail concern', seeing is not valuing, and with room every optimum drains what lies beyond whatever it aims at. Not stated: his claim that right aim and skill are one achievement. His distinction by name stands only in history, kept 'without identifying his ethical grounds with living significance'. [AI reading]

says.en: 'Stabilizing a belief is not validity, operational compatibility forces no metaphysics, and accurate prediction does not entail concern.'
'**Seeing is not valuing**: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.'
Reading [AI]: the law says what a reading must carry for a requirement to be met by one response; 'which requirement is right it does not say'.

Theorem (any set of outcomes; the breaks on the World): among eligible outcomes, every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond exactly where room holds. T3's clause on trained systems is conjectured, with partial support.

account_adds.en: Where reach alone ends up: with room, at optima, as low beyond as any eligible outcome. Short of optima, for trained systems, this is T3, conjectured with partial support.

source_adds.en: Not stated live: that practical wisdom needs virtue and virtue practical wisdom, one achievement formed together, and that cleverness is praised only when the aim is noble. His distinction stands at theories/becoming/history/WISDOM-AND-CONTEXT.md lines 110 and 132, and root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md line 225.

name.en: Aristotle: the voluntary, ignorance and regret

sense.en: An act is voluntary where its origin is in the agent and the agent knows the particulars. Done through ignorance it is involuntary only if one regrets it, otherwise non-voluntary. Ignorance one is responsible for, as the drunk's or of laws easily known, does not excuse. Praise and blame follow this.

reading.en: He answers what 07 §4.7 sets aside: scope, 'not of what one answers for'. His responsible ignorance has the form of 07's could-reasonably-be-foreseen, the negligence standard, which does not reward not looking and, like the rest, fails P4 where an effect lies beyond it. His regret test lies near agent-regret, cited for ownership wider than fault. An origin in the agent the account does not grant: responsibility is not shown to differentiate. Argued; the condition and C stay premises. [AI reading]

says.en: An AI reading, argued, not proved. '*What could reasonably be foreseen*, the negligence standard, does not reward not looking'; 'Both fail P4 wherever an effect lies beyond them'; 'Whether scope may depend on what can couple in is open.' Agent-regret: 'This supports ownership wider than what one intends, not all effects.'

'within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate'. One unfolding is a thesis, argued.
'Responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited'; choices take further premises, the lifting L and J1-J4 among them, following from neither the condition nor C.

account_adds.en: That what one answers for and whose losses count are two questions, and a law of what a selection can reach under the foresight candidates.

source_adds.en: An agent as the origin of an act, deliberate choice as its mark, and blame as what the inquiry serves. Whether scope may follow foresight, 07's third question, he does not ask.

name.en: Aristotle: the mean relative to us

sense.en: Too much and too little both ruin, as with food and exercise and health. Virtue is a state of choice lying in a mean relative to us, not the arithmetic middle, fixed by reason as the practically wise person would fix it. Some acts, such as murder or adultery, have no mean.

reading.en: Said of all excellence, this has a law's form for half the health analogy: a level held from two sides, settling within the gap to m, able to oscillate beyond it; and an order single-peaked at a given set point. Too much ruining has a thin form only: a need is a lower bound, though overcompensating giving can cycle for ever and end levels above a top. 'Relative to us' reads as supplied; a best level depending on other conditions is no such order. Nothing shows holding a level good. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World): within the gap to m, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever. Rules reading late need a wider band. Record: not shown 'That holding a level is good'.

Theorem: an order 'strictly single-peaked at the set point condition by condition' (any set of outcomes), with what it does beyond the family; the set point is given. Record, not shown: an agent's preferences form one; 'a tolerance band around the set point is not one, nor is a best level depending on other conditions'.

Theorem (the regime; whole numbers; band up to hi): every run within the band rests within 3 hi + 3 steps. 'Overcompensating giving can cycle for ever'. review/SCIENCES.md reports levels above a top the step keeps that end, with giving that overcompensates, though the point of no return does not say so.

account_adds.en: How wide a band a late reader needs, and that below its set point such an order drains what lies beyond as a rising one does. The record maps 中节 to the same law, also by AI.

source_adds.en: The mean as excellence of choice and character, fixed by the wise person; excess itself as ruin; acts with no mean at all. 07 lists 'constraints on acts' as not shown, and the priority of basic conditions is a commitment, not this.

name.en: Aristotle: goods have a limit, against a widening with none

source.locator: I.8-10 (1256b-1258a) on wealth; VII.4 (1326a-b) on the size of a city, as recalled

sense.en: True wealth has a limit, set by what living well needs; acquisition that takes money as its end seeks without limit, mistaking a means for the end. A city too has a right size: past it, like a ship two stades long, it is no longer one. Excess is a fault in what the thing is.

reading.en: C has no such limit: it ranks a course keeping all another's claims and adding a living one, so no addition can be too much. 07's law says a narrowing ranked above its widening, read right, weighs the item below zero; he would refuse that, excess being a fault of form, not a negative item. His right-sized city, argued good for living, has the shape of T8's refuter, a pure closing argued good for life. C is unasserted, warrant open; so is the condition, for scope. [AI reading]

says.en: C 'ranks a course above every course it widens', and does not 'rank mixed comparisons'. Neither C nor the condition is asserted.

Theorem (any type): where a ranking puts a narrowing above its widening by one item, either it does not rank the pair as its own order ranks the kept sets (a misread or a framing) or the item weighs at zero or below. 'That a judgment is such a ranking is a premise.'
Thesis T8, argued. 'Forbids and refuted by: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint counting everything positively, with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life.'

An expansion producing ever more novelty: 'answered; the order left open'. '生生 life in the whole, not novelty or scale'; one ending forms of life another course keeps is mixed and C does not rank them.
Beyond the source field: Parfit's mere addition and the Repugnant Conclusion '(C ranks a costless addition better; the philosophy dossier keeps what it owes open)'.

targets.part: the row beyond the source field: Parfit

account_adds.en: Why a mixed case stays undecided; that seeking 'more than now' needs an open world (03); and that an order ranking only something above nothing can be read as enough (§4.4, AI reading).

source_adds.en: That more can be worse with nothing lost: excess as a fault of form. Neither widening nor a tie at a threshold says this. Means taken for ends is nearest the reading in 03 of a habit become the fixed measure.

name.en: Aristotle and Thucydides: what is everyone's is cared for least

source.locator: Politics II.3 (1261b32-38); Thucydides I.141, as recalled

sense.en: What is common to the most receives the least care: each thinks chiefly of his own and leaves the rest to others. Thucydides has Pericles say the same of allied councils: each supposes his own neglect does no harm, so the common interest is ruined unnoticed. Aristotle uses it against Plato's community of goods.

reading.en: Thucydides's "each supposes his own neglect does no harm" has an exact form: where each of several can carry a need alone, a member is needed exactly where it is the only one, and three of one unit against a demand of two need none though some copy's giving is needed. So each can be right singly and the whole fail. Taking has the commons' form, near-definitional. Neither law says what anyone does or why. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World). With some member of a class needed and each able to carry the continuation alone, 'a member, exactly where it is the only member'; 'three of one unit against a demand of two being none needed though some copy's giving is'. Need is what continues on every possible course, read and not acted on.

Theorem (World: balance): 'Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more.' It restates the tragedy of the commons and overshoot 'in near-definitional arithmetic, not who ought to take less'.

account_adds.en: The exact arithmetic of when joint excess ends what depends on a condition, and how much of a feeder's giving is needed, in degree: its shortfalls.

source_adds.en: Not stated: that what is common in fact gets the least care, since neither law says what anyone does. His remedy, property private and use shared, with friendship and law forming that use. The account credits Lloyd and Hardin and names neither ancient.

name.en: Roman law: use and fruits, the thing kept whole

source.locator: Institutes II.4 pr.; Digest 7.1.1; on things common to all, Institutes II.1.1, as recalled

sense.en: Usufruct is the right to use another's thing and take its fruits while its substance stays intact: orchard fruit may be taken and the orchard may not be spent. It binds a named holder toward an owner, and is enforced at law. Air, running water and the sea are held common to all by natural law.

reading.en: A limit with the form of 02's renewal against consumption: the fruits and not the stock. But there the class belongs to the run and all that draw on the condition, not to one drawer's course, and two each within renewal can together consume it; the jurist's limit is read on a holder. So the law's subject differs and the join is this reader's. The word 'substance' is a lawyer's, not Aristotle's sense here. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). A formation renews in a run where every condition it depends or draws on meets, at every step, every dependence on it; the classes exclude each other and do not exhaust the cases. 'two drawers each within renewal can together consume it'. Which holds is visible 'neither in one configuration nor in the drawer's own course'.
Theorem (World: balance): 'Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more.' Near-definitional, 'not who ought to take less'.

account_adds.en: Where a limit held by each still fails: on a shared stock the own count misses the joint draw.

source_adds.en: Right, owner and remedy as what makes the limit hold. 07 shows no 'duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance', so the divergence is in the bearer: a law's relation against a jurist's entitlement. A flock under usufruct made up from its young (Institutes II.1.38, as recalled) is a carrying renewal in law. Natural-law commons are not read.

name.en: Cicero: true law, one for all, binding from nature

source.work: Cicero, De re publica; De legibus
source.locator: De re publica III.33 (preserved in Lactantius); De legibus I.18-19, II.8-13, as recalled

sense.en: True law is right reason in agreement with nature, constant and eternal, the same at Rome and at Athens; no senate or people can release us from it, and whoever disobeys flees himself. It stands in a Stoic lineage. The passage survives by quotation, and how far it is Cicero's own view is discussed.

reading.en: He asserts what the account holds open and does not claim: a warrant binding every mind. Here no verdict binding every possible mind is claimed; whether one exists stays open, coming neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone. A law of the theory is no such lex: it evaluates nothing and forbids through its hypotheses. Same word, no shared reference. The condition for scope and C for order are hypotheses, warrant open. He would read this as stopping short. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind. 'It stays open'. 'such a warrant, where it would ground the condition, comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; these do not show that none exists'.
Thesis T8, argued. 'No verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.' 'whether a stronger warrant exists stays open'.
'The word has three senses, kept apart.' A law of the theory 'is read off what it holds of and does not stand over it'; 'a law with content is conditional and forbids through its hypotheses'.

account_adds.en: What such a warrant could not come from, stated exactly.

source_adds.en: Reason shared by gods and humans as the ground of community, law as what makes a people, and a norm no assembly can repeal. No law here reads reason as such.

name.en: Aristotle: the friend as another self

sense.en: A friend is another self: one stands to a friend as to oneself, and perceiving a friend's good is part of one's own living well. Yet a true friend wishes the friend good for the friend's own sake. Such friendship needs shared living, so it is possible with only a few.

reading.en: 07 §4.7 asks for a criterion of 'one's own' narrower than all one's effects, stated apart from identity. Shared living offers one, and he meets the wrong bearer: the friend's good is part of mine yet wished for the friend's sake. But the law's reach does not fit: a closure runs through friends of friends, and friendship, few and by degree, is not transitive. So a privileged relation, costly, not refuted. Neither the continuation condition, for scope, nor C, for order, is asserted; warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: Argued, not proved. 'Is there a criterion of "one's own", narrower than all one's effects and stated apart from identity, that bears on whose losses count and not only on what is permitted?' 'The wrong bearer': a village's loss counted on my line counts as mine.

Theorem (any type; World instances): along a relation the presupposition sub-true is significance over the closure, super-true it is the condition. The laws derive neither presupposition nor invariance.
'A privileged relation is costly, not refuted; a perspectivist holding significance relative all the way down denies the condition consistently'. 'Which holds is not shown'.

Agent-relative reasons and partiality: 'answered'. 'partial choices are mixed comparisons, decided either way by weightings counting everything; C leaves gross partiality unranked where numbers differ'.

account_adds.en: What a relation chosen as one's own reaches and leaves out: only its closure, with the step more. Concern and scope kept apart: a bound on friendship's concern is not shown to bound whose losses count, and partial choices are mixed comparisons C leaves free.

source_adds.en: Why friendship and not kin or city; a limit in number; virtue as a condition of the friend. None of this is read in the account: 'friend' returns nothing in the chapters, GLOSSARY and the philosophy dossier.

name.en: Aristotle: virtue as settled character, formed by practice

sense.en: Virtue is a settled state of character formed by habituation: we become just by doing just acts. The good life is activity of soul according to virtue over a complete life, so a person's good is judged across a whole life and through what they have become.

reading.en: Habituation alone has a law's form: a rule read from the count of its choices keeps the choice that raised it, so what one has done sets what one does. Here that is value-free, and a once-useful habit become the fixed measure is locked seeking, though firm judgment is not its mark. For him a firm settled state is the excellence. His whole-life measure has the shape of 07's whole-run reading, none chosen, under C for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. Character as excellence is not taken up; the dossier records the gap. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; counts): a chooser taking the policy its rule weighs more, its count rising by one: the threshold 'divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves'. 08: counting the action taken, 'the value-free habit'.

Reading [AI, D65]: locked seeking forms when 'a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases'; 'It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement'.
'learning a disposition is not learning a reason'. Reading [AI, D65]: 'Coming to care can recognize a prior reason and create new ones'.
Conditional (C; World): the whole-run reading and the stepwise read one course differently: an overdrawer's 'events before the loss are included' only on the second. 'No reading is chosen.'

account_adds.en: That a habit's lock has exact regions, and that what it does not read can grow past every bound while it holds.

source_adds.en: An ethics of what a person becomes, where the account's appraises courses by what they admit; virtue as excellence and the noble as what habit aims at. Not stated live: review/PHILOSOPHY.md lists virtue ethics among views appearing 'only as objections or not at all'.

name.en: Stoic oikeiosis: what is one's own, from self to others

source.work: Stoic oikeiosis, reported in Diogenes Laertius and Cicero
source.locator: Diogenes Laertius VII.85-86; Cicero, De finibus III.16-22, 62-68; Seneca, Letter 121, as recalled

sense.en: An animal's first impulse is to preserve itself, its own constitution being made its own through self-perception. In humans, with reason, what is one's own comes to include others, grounding justice and a community of rational beings under nature. Reports differ, and how the step from self to others goes was contested in antiquity and is now.

reading.en: Both begin at self-concern, his an impulse of nature, 07's a presupposition of acting, unasserted. §4.3 reaches others only through need, a law of reach with no development. For his class, rational constitution, the nearest form is §4.2's closure along a supplied relation read as shared reason: it holds those one never touches, escaping 'Touching', and leaves out what else one ruins, a rival. §4.5's family does not give it: a family needs a chain of 缘. C's 'widening' is another reference. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World witnesses): one standpoint's presupposition along a relation, alone, forces 'exactly what lies within its closure'; held de se, each center's closure, 'invariant exactly where the closures agree, the condition exactly where each is the whole'. Whether a self is drawn along a privileged narrower relation 'is not shown'.

Theorem (any type; World): given the means-end step and the de se reading, drawn along need, the presupposition reaches exactly what the continuation needs. Reading [AI, D64]: human beings 'plausibly lie within one another's feeding closures'; 'Whether they do is empirical'.

Reading [AI, new]: what the dynamics leave open, held de se, is which class a center's own line runs under, and 'for what lies on no center's line, the step or a reading of one's own as one's family under the class (`«族无外»`); which holds is not shown'.

Theorem (root; witnesses): where members only feed from a condition they do not affect, the line from the first family's first member, under any relation, reaches no member of the second. Reading [AI, new], on the class of being joined: 'that the actual unfolding is joined in this sense is a correspondence, not shown'.

An AI reading, argued, not proved. 'Is there a criterion of "one's own", narrower than all one's effects and stated apart from identity, that bears on whose losses count'? 'A scope that follows effects leaves out what one never touches.' 'None is ruled out, and P4 is not shown.'

account_adds.en: That the step is exactly locatable, that a perspectivist denies it consistently, and three routes held apart: need (§4.3), effects (P4, §4.7), invariance (§4.2). Self-concern ranks one case with no C, and the ethics does not derive from it. The condition for scope and C for order stay unasserted, warrant open.

source_adds.en: Development: concern changing as a being comes to reason; one process at once recognition, motivation and warrant, which the account keeps apart. Scope for rational beings (Chrysippus denied justice to animals; Theophrastus, via Porphyry, argued kinship with them, as recalled). Warrant from providential nature, whose sympathy would supply the chain.

name.en: An ancient objection: attachment in degrees cannot ground equal justice

source.work: Anonymous commentator on Plato's Theaetetus (papyrus), attacking the Stoic view
source.locator: Commentary cols. 5-7, as recalled; locator unverified

sense.en: As I recall it, the commentator argues that we are more attached to ourselves than to others, and to some others than to others, so attachment comes in degrees, and justice cannot rest on it where interests conflict. The author is unknown, the text fragmentary, and my recall of the argument is uncertain.

reading.en: The objection has the form of what 07 states of grades: the step gives a positive grade, not status, and numbers count only if status is invariant and equal, which is not asserted. Held de se, each center reaches its own closure, invariant only where closures agree. It presses oikeiosis and the crux's route alike, and settles neither. The join is this reader's, on an argument recalled uncertainly. Neither the continuation condition, for scope, nor C, for order, is asserted; warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: After the theorem, in 07's text and not itself the theorem: 'The step gives a positive grade, not status: numbers count only if status is invariant and equal, which is not asserted.' Theorem (any type): invariant grades rank alike from every standpoint, not conversely.
Argued, not proved. 'From some to all. Nothing above closes the gap from some of one's effects to all of them.' Connectedness 'comes in degrees and is not transitive, so it is no class'.
Graded status, priority, sufficiency: 'answered, except constraints on acts': 'every grade positive is a positive weighting'.

account_adds.en: What invariance of grades gives and does not, as theorems on a finite listing; and that C's order, unasserted, is shared by every positive grading, so grades press equal standing and not widening.

source_adds.en: An attack on a rival school within a Platonist commentary, with justice as its concern, where 07 shows no duty or right.

name.en: Hierocles: circles drawn toward the centre

source.work: Hierocles the Stoic, fragment on duties, preserved by Stobaeus
source.locator: Stobaeus, Anthology 4.84.23, as recalled; locator unverified

sense.en: Each person stands at the centre of circles: mind, body, parents and siblings, wife and children, kin, neighbours, city, nation, humankind. The well-disposed person draws the circles toward the centre, for instance by calling cousins brothers. So concern comes in degree and can be moved by practice.

reading.en: His graded concern, every circle above zero, is one positive weighting, so C, unasserted, leaves it free: partial choices are mixed comparisons, decided either way. What he asserts and the account does not is that nearness should weigh, and that practice moves it, where nothing here moves a grade. His order is of kinship and custom, not feeding or influence, whose closures nest. The condition for scope, unasserted like C with warrant open for both, reads no nearness; grades are supplied. [AI reading]

says.en: Against the narrow reading: 'Parfit's R coming in degrees and the closures nesting (Flow.withinInfluence_of_withinFeeding)'. 'A privileged relation is costly, not refuted'.

Agent-relative reasons and partiality: 'answered'. 'partial choices are mixed comparisons, decided either way by weightings counting everything; C leaves gross partiality unranked where numbers differ'.
'Connectedness comes in degrees and is not transitive, so it is no class, and "some or all" leaves out holding in degree'. Argued, not proved.
Theorem (any type): a graded significance gives each item a natural grade from each standpoint; an item counts where its grade is positive. Grades are supplied.
Theorem (any type): for 0 < d ≤ n, every positive weighting with weights within n/d of each other ranks the first of two courses higher exactly where n q < d p; 'Actual dispersion is to be measured'.

account_adds.en: What grades then decide: a concave transform decides transfers C leaves mixed, a further premise; and how far weights can differ before two weightings rank a pair opposite ways.

source_adds.en: A practice of moving people inward, and degree tied to nearness. The account has neither a law of how concern moves nor a claim that nearness should weigh.

name.en: The Stoics: only virtue is good; losses are indifferent

source.work: Stoic ethics, reported in Diogenes Laertius and Cicero; Epictetus
source.locator: Diogenes Laertius VII.87-89, 101-105; Cicero, De finibus III; Epictetus, Enchiridion 1, as recalled

sense.en: Only virtue is good and only vice bad. Life, health, wealth and their loss are indifferent, some preferred and none good. What is not up to us cannot harm us. Living according to nature, which is reason, suffices for happiness.

reading.en: One clause coincides by accident: no law says a loss is a harm. But laws read no order, and the Stoics supply one: virtue alone good, life and health selected yet not good. Read as weights, a zero on what a course adds ties it with what it includes, a boundary of scope; selection is then a second order, not C's. Under the condition every continuation's loss counts, with no valence. A Stoic can select what C ranks and deny it is better: both premises unasserted, warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation has significance; not asserted; 'significance is neither graded nor necessarily positive'.
Scope 'fixes whose losses count: every continuation's', and C gives order; neither is asserted, each a hypothesis wherever used.
Theorem (any type; finite listing): 'a zero weight on what a course adds ties it with the course it includes; read as not counting the item, a boundary of scope'.

account_adds.en: That what counts and what ranks are two premises, which 08 calls a clarification.

source_adds.en: An order with virtue alone in it, and nature as its warrant; a practice of holding apart what is and is not up to us. The account's nearest is what couples in, which is no ethics.

name.en: The Stoics: one rational whole, ordered for the good

source.work: Stoic physics and ethics, reported in Diogenes Laertius and Cicero; Marcus Aurelius
source.locator: Diogenes Laertius VII.87-89, 147-149; Cicero, De natura deorum II; Marcus Aurelius, Meditations VI.54, as recalled

sense.en: The cosmos is one living, rational whole, its parts bound in sympathy and governed by providence. What happens is for the good of the whole, and to live well is to live in agreement with it: what is not good for the hive is not good for the bee.

reading.en: Interdependence has forms here, and 'life in the whole' shares words. But the account does not assume that becoming is good, no law evaluates, and with significance free the represented dynamics entail no premise. T8 names its premises, the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, and 生生 is not the whole's own good. Under the condition a part's loss counts as its own. A Stoic would call this stopping short. [AI reading]

says.en: 'without assuming that becoming is good'; 'No law evaluates: none says a loss is a harm or restraint better.' The ethics adds two premises, 'neither asserted, warrant open'.

Thesis T8, argued: 'For life, the way is 生生, life in the whole and its continuing generation' [AI reading, D1]; 'For life says whose way it is, not whose losses count'. No verdict binding every possible mind.
Theorem (World) and Conditional: under the condition what retains in the whole retains in every region, and not conversely. Route (b) reaches the whole 'only where it is one feeding closure'.

account_adds.en: Which regions a course retains, exactly; that retaining in a region does not give retaining in the whole.
