source_adds.en: Providence, reason in the cosmos, and assent to what happens as the good life. The account holds none of them, and offers its way for life, not from the whole's nature.

name.en: Epicurus: death is nothing to us

source.work: Epicurus, Letter to Menoeceus; Principal Doctrines; Lucretius, De rerum natura
source.locator: Menoeceus 124-127; Principal Doctrines 2; Lucretius III.830-977, as recalled

sense.en: Death is nothing to us: where we are, death is not, and where death is, we are not. All good and bad lie in sensation, and death is its absence. Lucretius adds a symmetry: the time after death is as nothing to us as the time before birth.

reading.en: A structural reading, proposed here: the strongest ancient refusal of a loss that returns to no one, which is what the condition's step counts. A significance stopping at a step is already a rival, and under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end. His argument, that a loss needs someone to bear it, goes further: 07 reads a loss by comparing courses, and live text does not meet his objection to that. Only the crux's study names him, as the narrow self. Neither the continuation condition, for scope, nor C, for order, is asserted; warrant open. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World witness): a significance caring only for continuations up to a step is a rival of the condition wherever there is a standpoint and a formation.
Reading [AI, new]: 'under an organism's class nothing of the self follows its end'; 07 §4.7 table: this organism's line reaches 'its own stages, to its end'.
'Losses are not effects.' 'The generations a poisoning forecloses occur nowhere on the course taken, so they lie on no line'; 'a loss is read by comparing courses'. An AI reading, argued, not proved.
'What the condition adds is significance for continuations whose loss returns to no one' [AI reading, D18, D19].

source_adds.en: Named as the narrow position at pf-path-and-crux/PHILOSOPHY-ROUND-1.md section 3, not argued with there. Not live: the subject requirement on any loss, the symmetry, and calm as the aim of the argument.

name.en: Epicurus: natural desires end; empty ones run without limit

source.work: Epicurus, Principal Doctrines; Letter to Menoeceus
source.locator: Principal Doctrines 15, 29, 30; Menoeceus 127-130, as recalled

sense.en: Some desires are natural and necessary, some natural only, some empty. Natural wealth is bounded and easily got, while the wealth of empty opinion runs to infinity. Desires for fame and honour without end rest on opinion. The aim is the removal of pain and disturbance.

reading.en: The seeking laws have this form: under a determined law a target is met at rest exactly where an unchanged state meets it, so 'more than now' cannot rest, and 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker. Near the definition, and how a target forms is not modelled. 无明 reads this, and knowing enough as a target met at a state the law leaves unchanged. His limit comes from what is desired; the law reads only the target's form, and 'runs that keep changing are not 无明'. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; determined law for rest): 'More than now' is met only by change; 'above all others' is met by at most one seeker, so no unchanged state meets it for two. 'A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled.'
无明: 'seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, grounded in, and not the same as, the position every formation selects from'.

account_adds.en: Enough under undetermined laws, and that where what stands runs down, no condition rises at arbitrarily late steps.

source_adds.en: Pleasure as the end, and that reasoning about limits dissolves an empty desire. No law here says a seeker can drop a target by reasoning, and the account adopts no hedonism. Which desire is empty is a judgment no law gives.

name.en: Empedocles and Lucretius: what lasted had what lasting needs

source.work: Lucretius, De rerum natura; Empedocles, as reported by Aristotle
source.locator: Lucretius V.837-877; Aristotle, Physics II.8 (198b), as recalled

sense.en: Earth once brought forth many forms, and those lacking what feeding and breeding need failed. What lives now has had some cunning, courage or speed, or use to humans, that kept its kind. Aristotle reports Empedocles' version and rejects it: regular outcomes cannot come by coincidence, so nature acts for ends.

reading.en: Reading what lasts as a record of what was met has checked forms here, narrower than his. A formation unsupported at a step leaves no descendant across it; with exact transmission a descendant's need was met at the giving step; after excess under the coupled gate every later member descends from one not depending on that family at the gate's need. T1, conjectured, reads persistence as certifying the joint draw. These read support and draw, not traits in general. No final cause enters, which Aristotle would refuse. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; World for support and transmission): 'a formation unsupported at a step leaves no descendant across it'. Where the flow transmits a dependence within δ, a descendant's need is at most the condition's level at the giving step plus δ; 'with δ zero the need was met then'.

Thesis T1, conjectured: whatever persists through many renewal cycles of a condition it depends on 'has had the joint draw on it, its own with every other drawer's, kept within the regime's margin'. Passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings (ONE-PAGE).

Theorem (World; any type for the founding laws): where a family of conditions ran into excess under the coupled gate, every member of a later cohort of descent is the offspring of a member that depended on no condition of the family at the gate's need.

account_adds.en: What would refute the certificate: a condition below a need measured in advance returning with nothing given from beyond.

source_adds.en: A history of forms, spontaneous generation, and the human use of some kinds. Aristotle's objection from regularity stays a live test of any reading with no ends in it.

name.en: Sextus and Agrippa: suspension, and the modes against any proof

source.locator: I.8-12; I.164-177 (the five modes); II.18-20 on the criterion, as recalled

sense.en: To any claim an equally strong opposing claim can be set, so one suspends judgment, and tranquillity follows. Disagreement, regress, relativity, hypothesis and circularity block any proof: a hypothesis taken unproved is as good as its opposite, and a criterion needs a proof that needs a criterion. The Pyrrhonist reports this and asserts no doctrine.

reading.en: The account's form looks like the mode of hypothesis conceded: premises named, the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open. But it does not suspend. Sextus would press that a machine check is a criterion wanting its own, though 08 limits the empty axiom report to logic. And he would ask why act under an unasserted premise; 07's open item says only that the ethics, life's stance, does not wait on a warrant. Kept as a test. [AI reading]

says.en: Open: whether practical reasons have a warrant binding every possible mind. 'It stays open', and the ethics, life's stance, does not wait on it.
The checker asserts that every source declaration in the pure core has an empty axiom report; the account says this 'concerns logic only' and that the real assumptions lie in the modelling.

account_adds.en: Standings that separate proof, argument, reading and open question, against his one verdict of equal force; conditional theorems that hold whichever way a premise goes.

source_adds.en: Tranquillity as the outcome of suspense, and a life by appearances without belief. The account has no such practice, and it answers what acting without warrant is only by that clause on T8's stance.

name.en: Sextus: induction cannot survey the particulars

source.locator: II.204, as recalled

sense.en: Induction from particulars is insecure: if it reviews some, an omitted one may overturn the universal; if all, the task is endless. So it cannot establish a universal. He says it as one more block to proof, asserting no doctrine of his own.

reading.en: Stated of all induction, this has an exact edge here. Given a bound on a course's states, 'induction is deduction': the extrapolation is silent before 2N − 1 and right from then on. Not given it, none is right at 2N − 2 on every such history, and data alone fix no untried value. So the bound carries what he denies, and it is itself a premise he would press. 08 credits Hume and calls this restated constructively. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; the bound on states in each law): 'Given the bound, induction is deduction: the extrapolation given N is silent before 2N − 1 and right from then on'; 'the bound buys silence, not speed'.
Reading [AI, D26]: checked laws match aspects of wisdom, among them '理 (data alone fix no untried value)'. 'The matching proves no coverage of wisdom'.
Learning and identification: closest prior 'Hume; Fine and Wilf (1965); Moore (1956); Gold (1967)', verdict 'restated constructively'.

account_adds.en: Where a bound makes extrapolation safe, exactly, and what the bound buys.

source_adds.en: His reach: that any such bound wants its own warrant, and that suspense follows. The law reads determined courses with a bound on states, which experience does not hand over.

name.en: Polybius: the cycle of regimes

source.locator: VI.3-9; VI.57, as recalled

sense.en: Regimes turn by nature: kingship, tyranny, aristocracy, oligarchy, democracy, mob rule, then a strong man again. Each degrades when successors, with no memory of the abuses that made it, use power for themselves, and falls when others bear it no longer. All that forms decays, so one can foresee a state's course.

reading.en: Parts have laws; no law gives his cycle. A rule read from the share it raises locks, and so can a counter-rule (Reading, D68). 'Bear it no longer' has a form: where others read a loss once it reaches a bound, the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many then. A taught rule passes only while teachers stand; no abuse or memory is modelled. So revolt is conditional, not decay's law. That actual rules read the share is a premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): under its premises the course locks; only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. 'That actual rules read the share is the premise.' A reversal held past the threshold is not absorbed.

Reading [AI, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects 'locks from any start by the step after its second reading step, as the rule it replaced did'. From a start against its reading it may never lock.

Theorem (any type): with the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', and the rule in force favouring the carriers, 'the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read'. Pools so drawn 'is not shown' of actual rules; in one trained judge the bridge failed.

Theorem (root; a family of models): taught by members, at s at most l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps. 'Not modelled: why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision'. One minimal model of one kind of institution [AI reading].

account_adds.en: That a lock need not fall, and exactly when it does: the turn is decided by the reading and the counts, not by a law of decay.

source_adds.en: A named sequence, its necessity, and forgetting across generations as a cause. theories/meta-attractor/README.md claims 139 and 143 name anacyclosis in a list, without this reading.

name.en: Polybius: the mixed constitution, each part checking the others

source.locator: VI.10-18 (VI.15-17 on each part needing the others); VI.57, as recalled

sense.en: Lycurgus, and Rome by trial, slowed the cycle by mixing monarchy, aristocracy and democracy, so that each part can block the others and none overreaches. Even so Rome too will decay.

reading.en: He credits mixture with slowing decay. Here a pool reads against the share where carriers' reading is not above the others', counts decide against a mirrored reading, a reader of the loss turns the course only in time, and two rules read from one share lock together: mixing helps where parts read differently and soon enough. Blocking is nearest giving that waits: each acting only where what it waits on gave, a withholding spreads, so checks can stall all. No law shows a check curbing overreach. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): the rule as a pool of its readers' readings; monotone in the share exactly where v is not above u; against a mirrored reading 'the counts decide'.
Theorem (counts): with others reading a loss once it reaches a bound, whether a reading turns the course for good is decided by the share at the step read and the next; later readings keep the lock.
Theorem (any type): two rules each read monotonically from one share, under its premises, lock together.

Theorem (any type: any formations and any relation of waiting): with memory, 'a withholding stays and spreads downstream along every chain of waits'; 'more waiting gives no more at any step'; with a source giving first all give again. 'It does not show how waiting forms, or that cooperation is good'.

Thesis T7, conjectured. In one trained system the conjecture that a judge is a pool of readers counted by kind failed: one note of the loss turned its reading. The model's law stands only within its hypotheses.

account_adds.en: Exactly when a reader outside the share comes too late, and that 'constitution is slower than law' has a law of pace (05's table, 02).

source_adds.en: Blocking as holding a part back from excess, where 05's law tracks only who gives. Offices, and a history of Rome as the evidence. Searching 'veto' finds nothing, and the form above is under another name; that mixture curbs overreach is in no law here.

name.en: Thucydides: in civil strife words change their reading

source.locator: III.82-83, as recalled

sense.en: In the strife at Corcyra and after, men changed the accustomed valuation of words to suit deeds: reckless daring was called courage, prudent delay cowardice, and party came before kin. He ties this to war, a violent teacher, and to human nature, and describes it as recurring while that nature stays.

reading.en: The form fails at his point. A law does hold of a reading formed from the side it favours: where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed at the next reading step, and the AI reading in 02 joins this to winners forming the minds that read. But he describes valuations turning with faction, in one history, with no share or lock; 05's law of codes reads forms, not valuations. And he asserts a human nature as cause. That actual rules read the share is the premise. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type): under its premises, 'from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked'. 'Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step'.
Thesis T7, conjectured; in one trained system the bridge failed. Reading [AI, D26 as revised]: 'winners forming the minds that read it is `ReadsShare` on the reading'.
Forbids 'an explanation that needs a determination no relation carries, such as an intrinsic value, a self with a nature of its own'. Argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: That the lock is exact where nothing beyond the share is read, and that a reading of the loss is one sufficient way out.

source_adds.en: Human nature as the cause, which 08's thesis forbids as explanation in the form of a self with a nature of its own; trust and kinship as what is lost; the moral weight of his telling.

name.en: Thucydides, the Melian dialogue: justice only among equals in power

source.locator: V.89-91, V.105, as recalled

sense.en: The Athenian envoys say justice is in question only between equals in power: the strong do what they can and the weak bear what they must. The Melians answer that a common good serves Athens too, which may one day fall. Athens takes Melos. This is speech within a history, and how far it is Thucydides's own view is disputed.

reading.en: 'Among equals' has the form of a significance bounded by a region, a rival, consistently held. The Melians' answer is self-concern's route, which reaches what one depends on, and the law's edge shows there: in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues, retaining everything for itself. So their reply binds only where Athens depends on Melos. The rest is the condition's, for scope, unasserted, and C decides no mixed case. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World) and Conditional (the condition): 'With each formation's significance stopping at its dependence, the clearer's part retains everything for the clearer and loses the dweller for the dweller'. Route (b) reaches 'the self and what it depends on'.

Theorem (any type; World): let B admit no item from an ending on and A agree with B elsewhere: 'from every standpoint whose continuation A adds to, every such order ranks A above B'; 'where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order ranks it higher'.
Theorem: 'in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues'. 'That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived'.

account_adds.en: The exact case where self-concern does reach: what it ends is needed by everything, itself included.

source_adds.en: Necessity as a law of power, the gods on the stronger's side, and the fall his narrative sets after it. No law here says what the strong will do.
